detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Research Synthesis: Scrambling, Decoherence, and Record Formation
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes initial findings regarding the interplay between information scrambling (chaotic dynamics) and environment-induced decoherence (einselection) in the emergence of objective records.
